title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Attachment Eligibility and Photo Inspection
content:
## Attachment conditions

1. Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage can be attached only to a vehicle scheduled on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy whose package allows physical damage.
2. Physical damage is added only while the auto policy status is bound or in force. The status is read from the policy record, matched on the policy the vehicle is scheduled on.
3. A financed or leased vehicle must carry physical damage with its lienholder or lessor as loss payee for as long as the lien or lease lasts.
4. New physical damage starts no earlier than the date of the request, except under the newly acquired vehicle rule.
5. The loan/lease payoff option can be carried only on a financed or leased vehicle.

## Photo inspection

New physical damage is pending inspection until a photo inspection of the vehicle is accepted. A vehicle bought new from a dealer with a bill of sale is exempt where the option provides that exemption (every option does) and goes active the same day.

**Inspection window.** Physical damage becomes active only when the photo inspection is accepted no later than the inspection window (10 calendar days on every option) after the physical damage effective date. Days are counted from the coverage effective date, that date being day 0, and an inspection accepted on the last day is in time. The effective date is read from the coverage record.

When the window passes without an accepted inspection, physical damage is removed the next day and the unearned premium is returned. A loss occurring while coverage is pending inspection is still covered when it is reported before the removal.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Coverage effective date | Inspection accepted | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 0 | Day 10 | Last day of the window | In time; coverage becomes active |
| Day 0 | Day 9 | Inside the window | In time; coverage becomes active |
| Day 0 | No inspection by the end of day 10 | Window passed | Physical damage is removed on day 11 and the unearned premium is returned |

A loss on day 6 to a vehicle whose coverage is still pending inspection is covered when it is reported before the removal on day 11.

## Status condition at a glance

| Auto policy status | Physical damage may be added |
|---|---|
| Bound | Meets the status condition |
| In force | Meets the status condition |
| Any other status | Not added |
